==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:inh|enm:serchen|tree=+}}
{{inh+|en|enm|serchen}}, borrowed from {{der|en|xno|sercher}}, {{der|en|fro|cerchier}}, from {{der|en|la-lat|circō,|,circāre|to circle; go around; search for}}, from {{m|la|circus}}. Unrelated to {{noncog|de|suchen}}, which is cognate with {{noncog|en|seek}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|sûrch|a=RP}}, {{IPA|en|/sɜːt͡ʃ/}}
* {{enPR|sûrch|a=GenAm}}, {{IPA|en|/sɝt͡ʃ/}}
* {{IPA|en|/sɑː(ɹ)t͡ʃ/|a=dialectal,obsolete|ref={{R:Hall PGSMS|1|12|42}}}}
* {{IPA|en|/sɛːrt͡ʃ/|/sɛrt͡ʃ/|a=Early Modern}}<ref>{{R:en:Dobson:1957|II|8|473|passage=''Search'' has ''ę̄'' in Levins, Bullokar (beside ''ĕ''), Gil (1619 edition), and Cooper (followed by Aickin), and ''ĕ'' in Gil (1621 edition), Hodges, Price, Poole, Cocker, Brown, and ''RS''.}}</ref>
* {{audio|en|en-us-search.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)tʃ|s=1}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# An [[attempt]] to [[find]] something.
#: {{syn|en|sweep}}
#: {{ux|en|With only five minutes until we were meant to leave, the '''search''' for the keys started in earnest.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=October 31 2012|author=David M. Halbfinger|title=|titleurl=http://www.nytimes.com/2012/11/01/nyregion/new-jersey-continues-to-cope-with-hurricane-sandy.html?hp|journal=New York Times|accessdate=31 October 2012
|passage=At least eight people died, and officials expressed deep concerns that the toll would rise as more '''searches''' of homes were carried out.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20241204080522/https://www.nytimes.com/2012/11/01/nyregion/new-jersey-continues-to-cope-with-hurricane-sandy.html?hp|archivedate=4 December 2024}}
# The [[act]] of searching in general.
#: {{ux|en|'''Search''' is a hard problem for computers to solve efficiently.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-14|author=w:Jonathan Freedland
|volume=189|issue=1|page=18|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly
|title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/commentisfree/2013/jun/07/obama-apple-google-facebook-tainted-prism Obama's once hip brand is now tainted]
|passage=Where we once sent love letters in a sealed envelope, or stuck photographs of our children in a family album, now such private material is despatched to servers and clouds operated by people we don't know and will never meet. Perhaps we assume that our name, address and '''search''' preferences will be viewed by some unseen pair of corporate eyes, probably not human, and don't mind that much.}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To look in (a place) for something.
#: {{ux|en|I '''searched''' the garden for the keys and found them in the vegetable patch.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|followed by "for"}} To look [[thoroughly]].
#: {{ux|en|The police are '''searching''' for evidence in his flat.}}
#* {{RQ:Locke Human Understanding|text=It sufficeth that they have once with care and fairness sifted the matter as far as they could, and '''searched''' into all the particulars.}}
#* {{RQ:Marshall Squire's Daughter|I
|passage=He tried to persuade Cicely to stay away from the ball-room for a fourth dance.{{...}}But she said she must go back, and when they joined the crowd again{{...}}she found her mother standing up before the seat on which she had sat all the evening '''searching''' anxiously for her with her eyes, and her father by her side.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2013-07-06|volume=408|issue=8843|page=68| title=[http://www.economist.com/news/finance-and-economics/21580518-terrible-name-interesting-trend-rise-smart-beta The rise of smart beta]| passage=Investors face a quandary. Cash offers a return of virtually zero in many developed countries; government-bond yields may have risen in recent weeks but they are still unattractive. Equities have suffered two big bear markets since 2000 and are wobbling again. It is hardly surprising that pension funds, insurers and endowments are '''searching''' for new sources of return.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|now|rare}} To [[look for]], [[seek]].
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|III|vi|passage=To '''search''' the God of loue, her Nymphes she sent / Throughout the wandring forrest euery where{{nb...}}.}}
#* {{RQ:King James Version|Ezekiel|34|11|passage=For thus saith the Lord {{smallcaps|God}}; Behold, I, even I, will both '''search''' my sheep, and seek them out.}}
#* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=7|passage=Anough is left besides to '''search''' and know.|year=1873}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To put a phrase into a [[search engine | search engine,]] especially one besides [[Google | Google.]]
#: {{ux|en|I '''searched''' "Paris Hilton" and found lots of unflattering stories.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive|obsolete}} To [[probe]] or [[examine]] (a [[wound]]).
#* {{RQ:Mlry MrtDrthr|3.16|2|I|xvj|passage=Now torne we to the xj kynges that retorned vnto a cyte that hyghte Sorhaute / the whiche cyte was within kynge Vryens / and ther they refresshed hem as wel as they myght / and made leches '''serche''' theyr woundys and sorowed gretely for the dethe of her peple}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Titus|II|3|text=Now to the bottome dost thou '''search''' my wound.}}
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|III|4|text=Thus when they all had sorowed their fill, / They softly gan to '''search''' his griesly wownd{{nb...}}.}}
#* {{RQ:Montaigne Florio Essayes|chapter=35|book=II|passage=His wife perceiving him to droope and languish away, entreated him she might leasurely '''search''' and neerely view the quality of his disease{{nb...}}.}}
# {{lb|en|obsolete}} To examine; to try; to put to the test.
